notes: Probe: "Miyazaki's The Wind Rises" 0.825; 'Disney films such as The Lion King' 0.655; 'brought a classic novel to the stage' 0.547 (' to'); 'production tells the story' 0.346; 'the highest grossing movie' 0.288 (arts context alone leaks); 'released several new cars' 0.020; 'companies such as the bank' 0.020.
